___

I connect researchers with e-Research services, capability, and support to enable them to conduct high-impact research at scale.

I provide trusted advice on managing research data, reproducibility in research, and open research practices.

I lead [ResBaz Aotearoa](https://resbaz.auckland.ac.nz/) and other upskilling events aimed at the research community.
